cayley-single.caption: The half-plane $\operatorname{Im}z>0$ (grey) and its image under $F(z)=\frac{z-i}{z+i}$ (checkerboard), joined by the elliptic M\"obius transformations $H_t$ that fix $p=1.366-1.366i$ and $q=-0.366+0.366i$, with $H_t'(p)=e^{2\pi i t/3}$, $0\le t\le 1$. Arrows are the paths $t\mapsto H_t(z)$ of 5 boundary points and 6 interior points, from $z$ (dot) to $F(z)$; each is an arc of a circle. Regions are shaded by a checkerboard of cell $1$ in the $z$-plane, carried by the map.

Arrows are the paths $t\mapsto H_t(z)$ of 8 boundary points and 17 interior points, from $z$ (dot) to $F(z)$; each is an arc of a circle. Regions are shaded by a checkerboard of cell $1$ in the $z$-plane, carried by the map.
